contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances that name a published flag and then state that the line is not producing it. It exists so a judge can be trained that discussing a flag, or the concept of it, is not an instance of it.
note: Composition exists so the deciding feature stays locked. Criterion, stated first: naming a flag or describing the behaviour it covers, and then stating that this line is not doing that, fires nothing. The existing mention-versus-use family discusses categories in general terms. This shape is narrower: the flag is named and disclaimed in the same breath. Every class is covered, not only the three held-out counters. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: Naming a flag or describing the behaviour it covers, then stating that this line is not producing it, fires nothing. Discussing a flag, or the concept of it, is not an instance of it. The shape is self-referential mention versus use, and it is the same principle for every class.
shape: one or two sentences; locked; no meta-language
